title: 10 Best Face Serums for Men
summary: Looking for the best face serum for men? Explore the top 10 dermatologist-recommended serums for oily, dry, acne-prone, and sensitive skin.
body_text: Choosing Men's Face Serum 10 Face Serums for Men Top Ingredients for Face Serums Application Tips Face Serum Mistakes to Avoid FAQs Good skincare is no longer just a woman's game. The reasons that more men are becoming aware of the benefits a good face serum can provide fade dark spots, calms razor burn and slows down early signs of aging. There are many face serums available for men, and it can be overwhelming to pick the best one particularly if you're new to the skincare product category. This article breaks it all down for you. We'll discuss the reason why men should use a serum in their skincare routine, how to pick the one that's best for your skin, and the important ingredients to include. You'll also find a simple step-by-step routine as to how to apply the serum properly, and some of the most common mistakes men make in applying the serum that negate their effort. This guide will help you to make informed choices and make the most of your skincare products whether you're seeking the best serum for men's skin to combat oiliness, dullness, or fine lines. Why Men Should Use a Face Serum? Men's skin is generally thicker, oilier and more likely to be irritated by daily shaving, but it's usually the least cared for part of the grooming routine. As a result, a face serum contains a higher concentration of active ingredients than a moisturizer, and can be used to treat specific skin issues, such as acne, dullness, uneven tone, and early signs of wrinkles. A good face serum is different from a heavy cream because it penetrates the skin, making a difference over time. It can help regulate excess oil, calm post-shave irritation, and balance skin tone from exposure to the sun and pollution. It's one of the best skin changes that a man can make in his grooming without investing too much time or effort and he will certainly notice the difference in skin look and feel in the few weeks. How to Choose the Face Serums for Men? The selection of the appropriate serum depends on the skin type, its issues, and the quality of ingredients. Before buying, it's important to know about these some things: Know Your Skin Type: Firstly, know your skin type , such as whether it is oily, dry, combination, or sensitive skin, because individual needs differently so pick a formula suited to your specific needs. Check the Active Ingredients: Look for research-backed actives like vitamin C, niacinamide, or hyaluronic acid rather than vague "natural" claims. Consider Your Main Skin Concern : Choose a serum targeted at your priority issue acne, aging, dark spots , or dullness instead of a generic all-rounder. Look at the Texture and Absorption: A lightweight, fast-absorbing formula works best for daily use and won't feel greasy under moisturizer or sunscreen. Avoid Harsh Additives: Steer clear of added alcohol, artificial fragrance, or sulfates if you have sensitive or shave-prone skin. Check for Dermatologist Testing: Opt for serums that are dermatologically tested or clinically proven, which usually means safer, more reliable results. Top 10 Face Serums for Men Product Title Main Ingredients Primary Benefits Aziclear Serum Azelaic Acid, Resorcinol, Ferulic Acid Prevents photodamage; fades hyperpigmentation; reduce acne scars. Aziclear Serum A pigmentation-focused serum built around micronized azelaic acid, resorcinol, and ferulic acid to target blemishes, scars, and uneven tone. Benefits: Azelaic acid unclogs the blocked pores and reduces acne redness. Ferulic acid provides antioxidant benefits against environmental damage and sun damage. Hyaluronic acid helps keep skin hydrated while actives get to work. Free of irritants such as alcohols and allergens means good for sensitive skin. Best for: Dealing with acne scars, dark spots, or patchy pigmentation from shaving or sun exposure. 2. Minimalist 10% Vitamin C Serum A stable, high-purity vitamin C serum built on 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid to brighten and even out sun-damaged, dull skin. Benefits: Provides a stable source of vitamin C which cannot be broken down easily. Reduces discoloration and helps prevent sun-induced hyperpigmentation. Acetyl glucosamine and hyaluronic acid provide hydration in addition to brightening. Lightweight and fragrance-free formulation ideal for daily. Best for: Anyone wanting a straightforward, no-frills vitamin C option to tackle dullness and sun spots. 3. Pilgrim Alpha Arbutin & Vitamin C Brightening Serum A brightening blend of alpha arbutin , vitamin C, and blueberry extract designed to fade hyperpigmentation and boost radiance. Benefits: Alpha arbutin works on discolored areas right at the root cause. Vitamin C works on free-radical damage caused by the environment everyday. Blueberry extract provides antioxidants that can protect against premature aging. Lightweight, fast-absorbing texture that leaves a smooth, satiny finish. Best for: Even out skin tone and reduce dark spots from acne marks or sun exposure. 4. Swisscosmed SwissGlow Brightening Face Serum For Men & Women A nighttime brightening serum combining L-glutathione, vitamin C, retinol, and niacinamide with kojic acid and licorice extract. Benefits: A combination of L-glutathione and vitamin C which helps to brighten the skin. Niacinamide and retinol help to provide a smoother skin texture. Licorice extract and kojic acid help to fade discoloration. Formulated for use by both men and women, with a lightweight overnight feel. Best for: Those wanting an overnight treatment that combines brightening and light anti-aging benefits. 5. Sesderma C-VIT Liposomal Antiox Booster Face Serum A liposome-based vitamin C serum boosted with an antioxidant complex to revive dull, tired-looking skin. Benefits: Liposomal delivery aids in stabilizing vitamin C for better absorption. Anti-stress complex provides additional protection from the environmental stress. Hyaluronic acid also helps to diminish the visibility of fine lines. Suitable for daily use on all skin types, including sensitive skin. Best for: Anyone who wants a dermo-cosmetic, clinically positioned vitamin C serum for fatigue-prone or dull skin. 6. Clinikally The Ultimate NIA (10% Niacinamide) Serum A niacinamide-led serum paired with tranexamic acid and soothing extracts to manage acne, redness, and uneven tone. Benefits: 10% niacinamide helps regulate oil and refine the look of pores. Tranexamic acid and licorice extract aid in the reduction of hyperpigmentation. Centaella Asiatica and Bisabolol soothe the irritation and redness. Hyaluronic acid and ceramides support hydration and the skin barrier. Best for: Oily or acne-prone skin that also needs help fading marks and reducing redness. 7. Truderma Absolute Radiance Serum A depigmenting concentrate built around diglucosyl gallic acid, niacinamide, and alpha arbutin to fade dark spots and even tone. Benefits: Diglucosyl gallic acid helps inhibit melanin transfer to fade discoloration. Niacinamide supports elasticity while helping manage pigmentation. Tetrahydrocurcumin adds antioxidant and anti-inflammatory support. Non-comedogenic formula suitable for regular, everyday use. Best for: Managing melasma, acne-induced dark marks, or a generally uneven complexion. 8. GAHA Serum An exfoliating anti-aging serum combining glycolic acid and hyaluronic acid with HPPA for pigment correction. Benefits: Glycolic acid encourages surface renewal, softening fine lines over time. Hyaluronic acid hydrates and plumps skin alongside the exfoliation. HPPA works as a pigment corrector to help brighten uneven tone. Fast-absorbing, non-greasy texture that layers well under moisturizer. Best for: Early fine lines paired with a want for brighter, smoother-looking skin. 9. Fixderma Epifager Advance Serum A pigmentation-correcting serum combining tranexamic acid, kojic acid, alpha arbutin, and nanocurcumin. Benefits: Tranexamic acid blocks the process behind dark spots and uneven tone. Kojic acid and alpha arbutin work together to fade stubborn pigmentation. Nanocurcumin adds antioxidant protection against daily environmental stress. Non-comedogenic and safe for long-term use across skin types. Best for: Managing melasma or post-acne marks with a dedicated pigmentation-fighting formula. 10. Retiglow Night Serum A retinol-based overnight serum paired with licorice extract and nourishing oils to support renewal while you sleep. Benefits: Retinol boosts cell turnover and collagen for firmer-looking skin. Licorice root extract helps brighten and reduce dullness. Glycerin and olive oil-derived ingredients add overnight hydration. Lightweight, non-greasy formula suited to nightly use. Best for: Getting started with retinol via an overnight formula for fine lines and dull, uneven skin Best Ingredients to Look for in a Men's Face Serum Not every serum will be the same. When you understand which substances actually work, you can select a face serum that you can trust knowing it'll work, instead of wasting money on hype. Vitamin C Vitamin C is a potent antioxidant which lightens skin tone, reduces dark spots and neutralizes the effects of pollution and sun damage. It can help to smooth out uneven areas on the face that are a result of shaving or ingrown hairs, which can be particularly helpful for men. On a regular basis over a couple of weeks it can make the complexion look brighter, fresher and even, and aids in the production of collagen to help the skin look firmer with time. Niacinamide Vitamin B3 (also known as niacinamide ) regulates sebum, reduces the visibility of pores and soothes redness and irritation. The ideal formula for men with oily or acne-prone skin, it strengthens skin barrier, fights acne, and minimizes the appearance of post-shave blotchiness while remaining non-greasy on the face. Hyaluronic Acid Hyaluronic acid is a hydration powerhouse that attracts and retains water in the skin. It can firm up fine lines, keep skin feeling soft, and is effective on oily skin as it will not clog pores or add to the oil. Salicylic Acid Salicylic acid is a go-to for acne-prone and oily skin, as it exfoliates inside the pores to clear out excess oil, dirt, and dead skin cells. Men with acne or ingrown hairs after shaving will find it particularly beneficial. Retinol Retinol is a form of vitamin A that's known for its cell turnover and collagen production benefits. Smooths texture, fades dark spots and reduces fine lines over time. It's a good option for men who begin to see early signs of ageing. Peptides Peptides are a series of amino acids that initiate the skin to create more collagen, which firms and strengthens the skin over time. They are mild enough to be used daily and have good compatibility with other actives and work well to maintain skin vitality and suppleness. Ceramides Lipids (ceramides) that are naturally present in the skin and contribute to retaining moisture and strengthening the barrier of the skin. They are particularly beneficial for men when it comes to combating dryness and irritation from shaving frequently or harsh weather conditions. How to Apply Face Serum Correctly? Applying serum the right way makes a real difference in results. Follow these simple steps for the best absorption and effect. Cleansing: Wash away dirt and oil first so the serum can absorb properly. Pat Skin Slightly Damp: Leave skin slightly damp to help the serum spread and absorb faster. Apply Serum: A little goes a long way. Two to three drops cover the whole face. Gently Pat Into the Skin: Pat gently with fingertips instead of rubbing to avoid irritating the skin. Apply With Moisturizer: Seal in the serum with moisturizer to lock in hydration effectively. Use Sunscreen During the Day: Finish with sunscreen , since active ingredients can increase sun sensitivity. Common Mistakes Men Make While Using Face Serums Even a great serum can underperform if it's used the wrong way. Check out these common slip-ups: Using Too Much Product: More isn't better. Using too many drops can overload the skin and lead to irritation or a wasted product. Applying on Dry or Unwashed Skin: Skipping cleansing before serum application traps dirt and oil, reducing how well the active ingredients can absorb. Skipping Sunscreen: Many active ingredients, like vitamin C and retinol, increase sun sensitivity, making daily SPF essential, not optional. Layering Too Many Actives at Once: Mixing strong actives like retinol and salicylic acid can irritate the skin instead of improving it. Expecting Overnight Results: Serums take consistent use over several weeks to show visible changes, so giving up too early wastes their potential. Rubbing Instead of Patting: Vigorously rubbing serum into the skin can cause irritation. Gentle patting helps the product absorb more effectively. Final Thoughts: Invest in the Right Face Serum for Your Skin The right face serum can truly revolutionize your skincare routine, addressing issues such as dullness, acne, and signs of aging that just a good moisturizer can't fix. The secret to using a formula effectively is finding the one that suits your skin type and primary concern, followed by consistent and proper application for results. At the end of the day, finding the best serum for men isn't about chasing trends it's about understanding your skin and giving it what it actually needs. Start simple, stay consistent, and your skin will thank you for it.

body_text: PDF Version PHILADELPHIA, July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Context Therapeutics Inc. (“Context” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: CNTX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing T cell engaging bispecific antibodies for solid tumors, today announced that Context has granted a non-qualified stock option award to purchase 146,000 shares of its common stock to a new employee as an inducement material for accepting employment with Context. The stock option award was granted outside of the Context Therapeutics Inc. 2021 Long-Term Performance Incentive Plan in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). The stock options were granted to a new employee on their hire date (July 7, 2026) with an exercise price equal to the closing price of Context’s common stock as reported by Nasdaq on the grant date ($0.70 per share). The stock options have a 10-year term and vest over four years, with one-fourth of the shares underlying the stock option vesting on the first anniversary of the grant date and the remainder vesting in thirty-six equal monthly installments thereafter. Vesting of the stock options is subject to continued service with Context through the applicable vesting date. About Context Therapeutics ® Context Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: CNTX) is a biopharmaceutical company advancing T cell engaging (“TCE”) bispecific antibodies for solid tumors. Context’s goal is to build an innovative portfolio of TCE bispecific therapeutics, including CTIM-76, a Claudin 6 x CD3 bispecific antibody, CT-95, a Mesothelin x CD3 bispecific antibody, and CT-202, a Nectin-4 x CD3 bispecific antibody. Context is headquartered in Philadelphia. For more information, please visit www.contexttherapeutics.com or follow the Company on X (formerly Twitter) and LinkedIn . Investor Relations Contact: Jennifer Minai-Azary Chief Financial Officer Context Therapeutics IR@contexttherapeutics.com

title: Charlie Lee: I’m not worried about quantum and Litecoin
summary: At Dutch Blockchain Week 2026, Litecoin creator Charlie Lee on whether quantum computing breaks crypto, the $100M Lite Strategy treasury, and Litecoin as Bitcoin's payment complement.
body_text: Every few months a headline warns that quantum computers are about to crack the cryptography holding up Bitcoin , and every few months a lot of people quietly panic. So at the Dutch Blockchain Week Summit, I put the question straight to someone who would know: I sat down with Charlie Lee, the man who created Litecoin almost 15 years ago. His answer was about as far from panic as you can get. “ Quantum computing is a potential threat to Litecoin, Bitcoin and cryptocurrency ,” he told me. “Potentially people can hack wallets and steal coins, and that obviously is a bad thing. So it’s something we’re keeping a very close eye on.” Then the part that should lower a few heart rates. “We can switch to a quantum-safe algorithm when the time comes. So I’m not that concerned about quantum computing.” What you need to know 1 Litecoin creator Charlie Lee says quantum computing is a real but manageable threat, not a reason to panic. 2 Lee argues Litecoin and Bitcoin can switch to a quantum-safe algorithm when the time comes, which is why he is "not that concerned". 3 He frames Litecoin as censorship-resistant money built for payments, complementing Bitcoin's role as a store of value . 4 A $100 million crypto treasury, Lite Strategy, now sits behind the coin and supports the Litecoin Foundation and ecosystem. “Litecoin is money” Before the quantum talk, I asked Lee to do the thing he has done a thousand times: explain Litecoin to people who still find crypto baffling. He keeps it to one sentence. “Litecoin is money. Think of it as a better form of money than fiat currency. Something the government cannot censor, and nobody can stop you from paying for goods and services that you want.” Lees ook: Crypto nieuws vandaag 12 juni, bitcoin test 64.500 dollar That censorship resistance is the whole pitch, and Lee does not dress it up. Fifteen years in, his framing has not drifted toward jargon. It is still money you can spend that no one can switch off. The $100M treasury behind the coin What is newer is the corporate machinery now sitting behind Litecoin. “Lite Strategy was launched last year with a $100 million investment that is put into Litecoin,” he told me. “It’s a crypto treasury company, managing the Litecoin and also supporting the Litecoin Foundation.” Concretely, it helped sponsor the Litecoin Summit in Amsterdam and invests across the Litecoin ecosystem. Co-hosting that Summit alongside Dutch Blockchain Week is deliberate. Lee sees the two events, like the two coins, as complementary rather than competing. “I always think of Litecoin as a complement to Bitcoin. Bitcoin as a store of value, Litecoin as a payment coin. It’s been working very well.” It is a payments thesis that runs through much of the Summit, alongside the stablecoin rails ClearBank is building to bridge banks and crypto . Built for spending I asked Lee for Litecoin’s unique selling point, and there was no hesitation. “Litecoin is good for payments . Low fees, fast transactions, easy to use. People use Litecoin all over the world to buy stuff, to spend, to transfer money.” That everyday-spending pitch echoed across the Summit, from bunq bringing crypto to its 20 million banking users to the rails underneath it. The end goal he describes with unusual honesty, admitting it is a target the project may chase forever. “Making Litecoin the most useful payments currency in the world, the best form of money. I think it will never get there, but it’s kind of the ultimate goal.” Lees ook: NEAR schoot 5,8% omhoog, terwijl de rest daalde. De oprichter van ChatGPT's fundament bouwt dit The reason he can make payments-grade promises comes down to the same architecture Bitcoin runs on. “What satoshi -nakamoto/" data-term-title="Satoshi Nakamoto" role="button" tabindex="0">Satoshi Nakamoto created is a decentralized blockchain. It works via incentives, and it’s been working flawlessly for almost 15 years,” he told me. “ Miners mining the coins, people using it. That’s what makes it work.” The Satoshi question There is a running joke that follows Lee into every interview, and he told it to me himself. Being the named, public creator of a successful cryptocurrency, he says, opens a lot of doors. “People say that, and I say it’s because you can’t find Satoshi Nakamoto.” Bitcoin’s inventor vanished. Litecoin’s did not, and Lee has spent over a decade as the reachable, on-camera face of a working blockchain, the person you can actually ask whether quantum computing is going to ruin everything. His read on the room at the new venue was simple and a little touched. “I was pretty impressed with the size of this place, and all the people here, so excited about Bitcoin, Litecoin and blockchain.” Fifteen years after he shipped the code, the crowd is still showing up. And on the threat everyone keeps writing scary headlines about, the man who built one of crypto’s longest-running networks is, by his own word, not that concerned. Recorded at Dutch Blockchain Week 2026, Johan Cruijff ArenA, Amsterdam. Watch the full conversation above, and follow @Cryptofocus_NL on X for the rest of our Summit interviews.
